details.method: Before releasing automatic acceptance, exercise actual multi-tool review and separate captured-candidate evidence from untrusted auxiliary context. Pin successful auxiliary reads at read time and recheck on completion, without admitting them as criterion evidence or re-pinning known bound receipt mismatches.
details.when: An automatic editor reviewer examines produced assets, accepted upstream originals, producer receipts and execution transcripts to decide downstream release. Ordinary review contracts remain unchanged.
details.counterexample: A terminal/registration-only exception passes simple upstream reviews but still rejects legitimate final integration cross-checks; accepting outside files as candidate evidence or re-pinning mutated bound receipts would invalidate the separation.
details.trial_plan: Run actual Codex A/B production and independent acceptance followed by C integration, multi-file/upstream/transcript review and one parent return. On the same candidate verify real navigation/context reads pass, context drift and bound receipt tampering fail, and external-as-evidence remains blocked. Independently execute the resulting game controls.
